# 10.00 CAD of cash opened from equity.
#
# What this fixture produces: three accounts and one transaction. The test that
# uses it adds an account with no commodity, as a book from another tool can
# hold one, and moves the cash account under it.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_account_with_no_commodity_is_left_out_of_the_export.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Cash
	type: Cash
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-02 * "Opening cash"
	Assets:Cash 10.00 CAD
	Equity -10.00 CAD
